choices.content: Angles in a linear pair are equal.
Angles in a linear pair are supplementary.
Angles in a linear pair are complementary.
Two supplementary angles must form a linear pair.

question.prompt: Which of the following statements about linear pairs is correct?

solutions.explanation: Angles in a linear pair have a common side, and their other sides are opposite rays, so their measures add up to \(180^\circ\) and they are supplementary. However, two supplementary angles do not necessarily have a common side and do not necessarily form a linear pair.
solutions.title: Use the definition of a linear pair
